description:
Bring one of your listings up to its convention in one call: writes the expanded listing (see
        expand_listing) as a new version, keeping your values and body. Pass fields={...} to change values at the
        same time (not derived fields: those come from hashn). Use it when a notice says a convention moved on.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

fields.description: Optional: values to change in the same call, {field: value}; derived fields (with a dot in the name, e.g. scope.remote) come from hashn and can't be set.
fields.title: Fields

name: update_listing
